entities.name: Callaphe
entities.description: A human trickster mariner from Meletis who sailed the Monsoon and is now Thassa's chosen demigod.

entities.name: Thassa
entities.description: The god of the sea who chose Callaphe as her champion.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: God who instructed Daxos to remove all trace of the other gods from Meletis.

entities.name: Purphoros
entities.description: God whose tears Callaphe was said to steal.

entities.name: Phenax
entities.description: God whose secrets Callaphe was said to have written down.

entities.name: Nyx
entities.description: Realm where Callaphe was said to claim her place among the stars.

events.summary: Callaphe becomes the first mortal to decipher the secret patterns of the winds, provoking Thassa's ire.
events.quote: She was also the first mortal to decipher the secret patterns of the winds

events.summary: Heliod has Daxos remove all trace of the other gods from Meletis; the other gods make their champions demigods in response.
events.quote: Thassa and the other gods, refusing to stand for such an affront, called upon their own champions from the Underworld and made them demigods .

events.summary: Thassa chooses Callaphe as her champion out of respect for outmaneuvering her krakens.
events.quote: Thassa chose Callaphe as her champion.

relations.quote: Thassa chose Callaphe as her champion.
